function lmr.vector(p)

function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end

local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)

 local size=bounds.size

  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)

Aurora VII | current territory rules and owner advantage. Open Map Rules at the top of the screen.

Rapid Transit Network
Troopers that already have Parachutist may arrive without spending their own Order. They retain that Order for use after arrival; Regular and Irregular Orders retain their normal restrictions.

Arrival generates AROs and follows normal Parachutist placement restrictions, including no Partial Cover during the arrival Order. This rule does not grant Parachutist.

OWNER ONLY
Transit Priority: Before deployment, choose one friendly trooper that already has Parachutist. It gains Tactical Awareness in addition to the rapid transit benefit. A trooper that already has Tactical Awareness receives no second Tactical Order.

SCOPE AND TIMING
Rules revision: 30 October 2026. Matches Aurora VII Territory Special Rules revision 2026.10.30.

Territorial games: both players use this battlefield rule and the current Campaign Event. Only a player registered to the controlling Conquest faction receives the owner advantage. Ownership is the recorded controller at the start of the Campaign Turn and stays fixed throughout that Turn. NA2 employment, Tohaa support and CA Infiltration do not transfer the advantage.

Narrative games: territory rules and owner advantages do not apply unless the current Narrative Mission sheet explicitly names them. Use that sheet and the current Event instead.

Apply normal points, SWC, availability and army composition, plus territory exclusions. Before deployment, agree water, trails, clearings, building interiors and other terrain boundaries. The current mission sheet governs deployment and mandatory objective positions. Campaign exceptions override the corresponding baseline only where stated; apply territory and Event rules together. A prohibition overrides an ordinary permission or benefit. Obtain a GM ruling before deployment if effects cannot be reconciled.

Make pre-game selections after the final army is confirmed and before either player deploys. Declare the selection to your opponent; record it privately with the GM instead if identifying the trooper would reveal information protected by the normal rules. Declare once-per-game benefits and rerolls in their stated window. Do not reroll a roll more than once unless a rule expressly allows a further reroll. Selection and usage tracking are reminders, not automated game enforcement.
Mission: six independent reference tabs. Deployment: thin forward boundaries only; no backs or sides.

-- BEGIN LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1
-- Coordinates and line widths are measured in tabletop inches.
local loboZonePalette={
 {name='Red',rgb={1,0,0},hex='#FF0000FF'},
 {name='Orange',rgb={1,.45,0},hex='#FF7300FF'},
 {name='Yellow',rgb={1,1,0},hex='#FFFF00FF'},
 {name='Green',rgb={0,1,0},hex='#00FF00FF'},
 {name='Blue',rgb={.10,.35,1},hex='#1A59FFFF'},
 {name='Indigo',rgb={.50,.20,1},hex='#8033FFFF'},
 {name='Violet',rgb={.90,.08,1},hex='#E614FFFF'}
}
local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and n>=1 and n<=7 and n or default
end
local function loboZoneVector(p)return Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3])end
local function loboInk(target,out,points,kind)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() or #points<2 then return end
 kind=kind or 'deployment'
 local scale=target.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function stroke(path)
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={.015,.015,.015},thickness=.15/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=true}
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={1,0,0},thickness=.10/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=false}
 end
 if kind~='exclusion' then stroke(points);return end
 local step,length=.50,.12
 local nextDot,distance=step*.5,0
 for i=2,#points do
  local a,b=loboZoneVector(points[i-1]),loboZoneVector(points[i])
  local aw,bw=target.positionToWorld(a),target.positionToWorld(b)
  local span=math.sqrt((bw.x-aw.x)^2+(bw.z-aw.z)^2)
  while span>0 and nextDot<=distance+span do
   local t0=math.max(0,(nextDot-distance-length/2)/span)
   local t1=math.min(1,(nextDot-distance+length/2)/span)
   stroke({{a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t0,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t0,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t0},
           {a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t1,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t1,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t1}})
   nextDot=nextDot+step
  end
  distance=distance+span
 end
end
-- One generation per MAT, shared by every contributing script. Late jobs cannot
-- restore old guides after Off, another selection, a clear, or a color change.
local function loboZoneWrite(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local combined={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do if not line.loboStandardGuide then combined[#combined+1]=line end end
 for _,line in ipairs(target.getTable('LoboStandardGuides')or{})do combined[#combined+1]=line end
 source=combined
 target.setTable('LoboZoneSourceR1',source or {})
 local generation=(target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1') or 0)+1
 target.setVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1',generation)
 local colors=target.getTable('LoboZoneColorsR1') or {}
 local result,tasks,cache={},{},{}
 local bounds=target.getBounds()
 local floor=bounds.center.y+bounds.size.y/2
 local tags={};for _,tag in ipairs(target.getTags() or {})do if tag:sub(1,8)=='LoboMap:' then tags[tag]=true end end
 local function terrain(o)
  if not o or o.isDestroyed() then return false end
  if o==target then return true end
  if o.hasTag('mission') or o.hasTag('controller') or o.hasTag('LoboBackgroundController') then return false end
  for tag in pairs(tags)do if o.hasTag(tag) then return true end end
  return false
 end
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do
  local kind=line.loboZoneKind
  if not kind then result[#result+1]=line
  else
   local rgb=kind=='scoring' and {.92,.94,1} or loboZonePalette[loboZoneIndex(colors[kind],kind=='exclusion' and 3 or 1)].rgb
   local path={}
   local copy={points=path,color=line.loboZoneEdge and {.015,.015,.015} or rgb,thickness=line.thickness}
   result[#result+1]=copy
   local function point(w)
    local key=string.format('%.5f:%.5f',w.x,w.z)
    local entry=cache[key]
    if not entry then entry={world=w,points={}};cache[key]=entry;tasks[#tasks+1]=entry end
    local p={0,0,0};path[#path+1]=p
    local lift=line.loboZoneEdge and .035 or .042
    if kind=='exclusion' then lift=lift+.009 end
    entry.points[#entry.points+1]={p=p,lift=lift}
   end
   local previous=nil
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points or {})do
    local w=target.positionToWorld(loboZoneVector(p))
    if previous then
     local distance=math.sqrt((w.x-previous.x)^2+(w.z-previous.z)^2)
     local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/.5))
     for j=1,count do local t=j/count;point(Vector(previous.x+(w.x-previous.x)*t,0,previous.z+(w.z-previous.z)*t))end
    else point(w)end
    previous=w
   end
  end
 end
 local index=1
 local function step()
  if self.isDestroyed() or target.isDestroyed() or target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1')~=generation then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local item=tasks[index]
   if not item then target.setVectorLines(result);return end
   local w=item.world;local y=floor
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(Physics.cast,{origin={w.x,math.max(50,floor+40),w.z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=100})
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or {})do
     if hit.point and terrain(hit.hit_object) then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y)end
    end end
   end
   for _,ref in ipairs(item.points)do
    local p=target.positionToLocal(Vector(w.x,y+ref.lift,w.z))
    ref.p[1],ref.p[2],ref.p[3]=p.x,p.y,p.z
   end
   index=index+1
  end
  Wait.frames(step,1)
 end
 if #tasks==0 then target.setVectorLines(result)else Wait.frames(step,1)end
end

local function xmlEscape(value)
 local s=tostring(value or '')
 s=string.gsub(s,'&','&')
 s=string.gsub(s,'<','<')
 s=string.gsub(s,'>','>')
 s=string.gsub(s,'"','"')
 s=string.gsub(s,"'",''')
 s=string.gsub(s,'\r','')
 s=string.gsub(s,'\n','
')
 s=string.gsub(s,'\t','	')
 return s
end
local function xmlNode(entry)

  table.insert(out,' '..key..'="'..xmlEscape(value)..'"')
 end
 table.insert(out,'>')
 if entry.value~=nil then table.insert(out,xmlEscape(entry.value)) end
 for _,child in ipairs(entry.children or {}) do table.insert(out,xmlNode(child)) end
 table.insert(out,'</'..entry.tag..'>')
 return table.concat(out)
end

 {name='Yellow',rgb={1,1,0},hex='#FFFF00FF'},

local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)

end

 local function place(tag,source,prior,move)
  local key="LoboToolPlacement6_"..tag
  local lease=Global.getTable(key) or {}
  if lease.expires and lease.expires>os.time() and getObjectFromGUID(lease.owner) then return false end
  Global.setTable(key,{owner=self.getGUID(),expires=os.time()+5})
  local ok,obj=pcall(function()
   if not prior then return spawnObjectJSON({json=source}) end
   local data=JSON.decode(source)
   prior.setName(data.Nickname)
   prior.setDescription(data.Description)
   for _,t in ipairs(data.Tags) do prior.addTag(t) end
   if move then
    local t=data.Transform
    prior.setRotation({t.rotX,t.rotY,t.rotZ})
    prior.setScale({t.scaleX,t.scaleY,t.scaleZ})
    prior.setPosition({t.posX,t.posY,t.posZ})
    prior.setColorTint(data.ColorDiffuse)
   end
   prior.setLuaScript(data.LuaScript)
   return prior.reload()
  end)
  if not ok or not obj then Global.setTable(key,{});return false end
  return true

 local function ensureButton(side,source)
  local tag="LoboArmyLauncher"..side
  local found=(getObjectsWithTag(tag) or {})[1]
  if found and (tonumber(found.getVar("LOBO_ARMY_LAUNCHER_REVISION") or 0) or 0)>=10 then return true end
  if not found and side=="Blue" then
   for _,old in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag("LoboArmyLauncher") or {}) do
    if not old.hasTag("LoboArmyLauncherRed") then found=old;break end
   end
  end
  return place(tag,source,found,true)
 end
